E1_convergence_model_credible.criterion: the fitted v(N)=v_inf+C*N^-p reproduces the last three rungs of every (quantity, ka) cell to within 0.3%

E2_observed_order_identified.criterion: observed order stays inside [0.1, 4] and shifts by < 25 % between the all-rung and last-four-rung fits, for every cell

E3_extrapolation_stable.criterion: v_inf fitted on the last four rungs vs on all rungs agree within 0.5% for every cell

E4_frozen_level_residual.criterion: the anchor's frozen 1600-panel level sits below 2% from the extrapolated limit (it is a discretised value, not a converged one)

E5_adjudicated_spread.criterion: |reference/v_inf - 1| < 2% for every cell: the independent axis confirms the reference once its own discretisation error is removed

E6_extrapolation_moves_toward_ref.criterion: at the published worst cell (B33, ka=2) extrapolation reduces the distance to the reference: |ref-v_inf| < |ref-v(1600)|
